findings.text: The owner's first name is hard-coded in new hook text, tool text, tests and the record
Rule text says a retest is never held at push, but the project pre-push hook still holds test-change and retest pushes (project relax is deferred)
stale comment says a retest waits on the owner's yes
unit-check prints owner yes needed for each retest
example describes old trial pauses
hook-error tier list omits the security tier
retest titles promise widening, reset and pause; bodies only assert absence
retests replaced distinct refusal texts with a shared weaker one
notEqual allow passes when the guard does not detect the act
No test shows the kit pre-push still holds tag or force pushes; retested loops only check status 0
retested test titles still say holds or pauses while asserting the opposite
retests replaced positive pause assertions with doesNotMatch only
sweep lock behaviours with no test: since filter, log mode, general agent in a build role, Ticket: NONE
holds.json test only re-reads JSON
unwritable-log fixture depends on chmod
tier() duplicate-entry rule untested
leadGate printed-command safety and edge branches untested
repeat tests are second proofs of stateless functions
alive(pid) with no start-time check: a dead supervisor plus PID reuse blocks the kind forever, and stop kills an unrelated process tree
one lead-state pass per git common folder; two sessions overwrite each other's pass
skill says write the file list after the spawn, but the hold refuses the spawn without it; git-path command lacks -C
investigation side job runs under the same denying hooks, no kind named, refused while another of its kind runs
on Windows the bare-name candidate wins over PATHEXT, so an npm shim breaks every side job
folder guard protects only two folders
U25 and U27 claim reach projects and list the project hook, which the diff does not change
only a broken safety net pauses is overstated; other pause causes remain
High tier bullet says pause, the high-tier block bullet says keep building
each arm folder holds only the login, so recall.mjs refuses it (no kit-install.json) and both arms fail
after a Rows change the build is stuck: defer leaves the fault, --lock-rows will not re-lock, only hand edits get out
defer command prints the whole Rows line raw in double quotes
probe login gated on access-token expiry; refreshed tokens thrown away
load hold exits at once though docs say it waits; no retry line
laneOf splits only on comma and then
call-cap (tier high) passes the call on every crash: safeCheck swallows the throw before guard.cjs hookFailed
a crash in agent-model high-tier holds passes every non-checker spawn
a crash at module load escapes the try and exits 1, non-blocking on the direct role-file path
plugin SubagentStop: missing hook-error.cjs lets the stop through with no row
a deterministic Stop-path crash exits 2 every stop, so the agent can never stop
kit-gate (small) blocks every prompt when its helper is missing or tiers unreadable
a decoy line with the same key and the old number takes the first-match pairing, so a raised timeout passes the hold and closeout
a reviewer on another or unreadable model is only printed: no pause, no warning row, counted clean
release record matches its tag case-insensitively
an unheld call cap only prints when unbounded though the header says it pauses
a hand edit before the last resume sets no pause (pre-existing)
kit-hook legs of the retest-push and marker tests cannot fail; dead owner-yes controls; titles say refuses
branch === def term never decides in any test
process.exit(0) inside a new block passes (already a defer row)
test name says both hooks pass but asserts project hook held; ci-budget pin lost job name
sweep lock role check is an allow-list: Explore/Plan, a Role: line with no listed word, 'lead reviewer', 'reviewers' pass
a ticket is single-use, so the tester-then-builder pair is refused at the builder; a ticket for a spawn that never ran stays used
Ticket: none never used up
sweep lock keyed on branch name only (already a defer row)
lead-state gate skips SendMessage, is off when the record is moved, pass file unsealed (partly a defer row)
one non-JSON line in kit-guard-open.log makes write and check full-read for good, refusing every spawn
sweep lock reads findings from the working tree
a fresh test( block counts as pure addition but its arguments run at load or in an old test's scope, switching off asserts
CI secret scan reads only the net diff; a key added then removed passes CI and stays in history
all scans skip files git treats as binary
closeOf ignores regex literals, so return; can ride inside a fresh block in an old test body
test runner and CI wiring are not test paths, so a commit can drop tests unlisted
PR body check accepts a hidden retest name
a retest subject goes into the step summary unescaped; an open HTML comment hides later retest lines
a failed job with no failed step counts as a lost runner; PR code can produce that
subjects and paths printed with control characters
ci-audit prints job and step names raw
